title: Share pinned published report configurations within recipient permissions
description: Owner can grant/revoke read access to a specific immutable published revision for an existing active ERP user using recipient user ID; do not expose a user directory or permit role-wide grants. Persist narrow grant metadata with recipient/configuration/revision, entity audit and concurrency; list/grant/revoke is owner-only, optimistic concurrency prevents stale grant changes. Pin stays at its selected revision when owner publishes again; changing the pin is explicit owner action. Recipient shared list/detail exposes only granted published snapshot, never private drafts, other revisions/history or owner editing. Shared preview/Excel/PDF resolves grant again and validates recipient's own current menu/field/row scope through existing dataset provider, never author's scope. Revoked/deleted config, inactive recipient, missing/unpublished revision or lost underlying ERP permission fails closed. Copying shared snapshot creates a recipient-owned private draft after fresh validation, never edits original. Add shared/owned UI distinction and explicit owner grant/revoke controls with escaped input and retained state on conflict. Persist normal Domain/EF code but no runtime schema provisioning or migration; unavailable grant tables are environment blocked. Reuse existing user lookup abstraction/DbSet in IErpDbContext without changing user management. Stage 1 unified platform only; existing sales-order/receivable adapters are engine fixtures, not migration or new bespoke reports. Preserve old report entries until every fixed/dynamic report passes Stage 2 parity. No Agent or cross-business flow work. Server-authenticated identity and fresh existing menu/field/row/data scope remain authoritative, saved definitions/grants never grant ERP permissions. No arbitrary SQL, scripts, joins, tables, mixed currency/unit totals or one-to-many header duplication. No migrations, SchemaUpgrader/SeedData modifications, production SQL/database execution, schema/view/procedure changes, secrets/.env/config changes, deployment or irreversible operations. Use existing HTTP and entity audit conventions. Safe build/test and relevant offline integration tests required; missing actual DB/browser/font environment must be explicitly blocked, never claim the phase complete from build. Preserve unrelated source/work.
acceptance_criteria: Owner grant/revoke pins an immutable published revision, records audit/concurrency and persists grant with precise Domain/EF mapping; private drafts/history remain inaccessible.
Recipient shared list/detail/copy/preview/Excel/PDF rechecks grant and recipient ERP permissions, revocation/deletion/inactive users fail closed and originals cannot be edited.
Customer UI distinguishes owned/shared revisions, supports owner grant/revoke and safe clone; offline service/EF/API/UI concurrency and authorization tests pass safe build/test.
